thread:
Lucas (sales): OrionEdge RFI just came in. They want a short capability matrix + complete security questionnaire + three tiered POC pricing. PDF attached to CRM: https://crm.redwood/deals/ORION-22/rfi.pdf
Priya (solutions): Picking this up. I'll map the RFI sections to our product docs and build the capability matrix. Want the POC target: functional bench (7 days), integration (10 days), acceptance (3 days)?
Ethan (eng): That sounds fine. For performance, note our typical baseline for 70B-class models on Dedicated: p50 token latency ~180ms (A100-80GB) at batch=8. I'll paste a short benchmark summary to the matrix.
Rina (security): Two immediate flags: they require HSM-backed key control + customer-managed KMS options. They also asked for audit log retention and syslog/ SIEM integration details.
Lucas (sales): They marked data residency as EU-only and have stricter egress rules. Legal will need the final wording on data flows.
Priya (solutions): I'll add an EU deployment option in the POC. Pricing tiers: 1) Proof-of-concept hosted (pay-as-you-go), 2) Dedicated short-term commit (4 weeks), 3) Private on-prem eval (lift+shift fee). I'll draft ranges.
Ethan (eng): Note: private on-prem has a one-time install fee and optional remote-support contract. Also call out quantization caveats for custom ops — we need to confirm operator parity.
Rina (security): For the questionnaire: we support SOC2 Type II; FedRAMP not supported currently. HSM: we can integrate with customer HSM via PKCS#11 or use cloud HSM (customer key control). Audit logs: 90 days default, options up to 365 days. SIEM: supports syslog forwarders and S3 export.
deploy-bot: Reminder: upload capability-matrix.csv and rfi-answers-v0.docx to deal folder: https://crm.redwood/deals/ORION-22/files
Priya (solutions): POC acceptance criteria ideas: latency p50 < 250ms, throughput >= 1k tokens/s baseline, inference error rate < 0.5% on prompt set. I'll add them to the runbook.
Lucas (sales): Buyer asked about support SLAs during POC. Can we provide 2hr POC support response and an escalation channel?
Ethan (eng): Yes for Dedicated/Hosted POC we can offer dedicated SE hours (8hrs/day) and a PagerDuty escalation for infra incidents. For Private on-prem, remote support only unless we sign an on-site SOW.
Rina (security): I'll prepare short, non-legal answers for the questionnaire and mark items that need legal review (data residency, egress restrictions, SLA indemnities).
Priya (solutions): Quick snippet for the runbook network test to include:
```
# connectivity smoke test
- allow egress to: 52.22.11.0/24, 3.101.45.0/24
- test ports: 443, 22 (for on-prem agent)
- verify TLS 1.2+ and mutual TLS for control plane
```
Lucas (sales): Deadline: first draft RFI answers + matrix by Wednesday COB. Pricing table and POC quote by Thursday AM. Can everyone confirm?
Ethan (eng): Confirmed. I'll add benchmark numbers to the CSV tonight.
Rina (security): Confirmed, will upload answers by Tuesday EOD.
Priya (solutions): Confirmed. I'll assemble the runbook and price table.
deploy-bot: Files added: orionedge-capability-matrix.csv, orionedge-poc-pricing.xlsx, orionedge-runbook.md
Lucas (sales): Great. I'll prep the buyer email after we compile. React :white_check_mark: when you upload your piece.
Ethan (eng): :white_check_mark:
Priya (solutions): :white_check_mark:
Rina (security): :white_check_mark:
